---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible problem
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Environment:** VoxKey version/build, macOS version, Mac chip, destination app/version.

**Steps to reproduce:** Use a made-up sentence, never real dictation or private vocabulary.

**Expected / actual behavior:** Include whether the text appeared, was duplicated, or went to Safety Net.

**For latency:** Approximate sentence length and time from release to delivery; Capture Sounds on/off; first dictation after launch or subsequent dictation.

**Diagnostics:** Sanitized screenshots or error messages only. Remove destination content, names, audio, and secrets. Report security issues privately as described in SECURITY.md.
